user.title: Choose a data source
user.description: Usage data can be read straight from Anthropic, or through a CLI Proxy API instance that already holds your Claude accounts.

reconfigure.title: Change this entry's data source
reconfigure.description: Pick where this entry should read usage data from. Its sensors and their history are kept either way.

official.title: Authenticate with Claude
official.description:
To authenticate, [open this link]({url}) to log in with Anthropic.

After authorizing, paste the authorization code below.

Note: The code may include a '#' character - paste the entire string.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Claude
reauth_confirm.description: Re-authenticate this entry (your token expired or was revoked, or you want to switch to a different Claude account). [Open this link]({url}) to log in with Anthropic — make sure you are logged in as the account you want this entry to track. After authorizing, paste the new authorization code below.

cliproxy.title: Connect to CLI Proxy API
cliproxy.description:
Enter the address of your CLI Proxy API instance and its management key. Home Assistant will then let you pick one of the Claude accounts stored there — no separate login is needed, and no tokens are kept here.

If Home Assistant does not run on the same host as the instance, that instance needs `remote-management.allow-remote: true`.

Security note: the management key grants full control over the instance, including its configuration, its logs and all credentials it holds. It is stored in plain text in Home Assistant's configuration.

reauth_cliproxy.title: Reconnect to CLI Proxy API
reauth_cliproxy.description:
This entry can no longer read its usage data. Confirm the connection details below and pick the account again.

If the account is listed but keeps failing, its Claude credential has expired inside CLI Proxy API — sign that account in again there, then come back here.

cliproxy_account.title: Choose a Claude account
cliproxy_account.description: These are the Claude accounts stored in your CLI Proxy API instance. Each entry tracks one account; run this setup again to add another.

error.exchange_failed: Failed to exchange code for tokens. Please try again.
error.invalid_base_url: Enter a full address including http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the CLI Proxy API instance at that address
error.invalid_auth: The instance rejected that management key
error.no_claude_accounts: That instance has no Claude accounts stored. Sign one in there first.
error.credential_rejected: Anthropic rejected that account's credential. Sign it in again inside CLI Proxy API.

abort.already_configured: This Claude account is already configured

init.description: Configure polling interval. Note: the usage API has rate limits, so avoid setting this too low.
